skill.summary: Markdown 一键同步到 Notion、GitHub Wiki、Medium 等平台

latestVersion.changelog:
markdown-sync-pro v1.0.0 - Initial Release

- One-click publish Markdown to GitHub Wiki, Notion, Medium, or local HTML.
- Supports standard Markdown, code highlighting, tables, images (with auto-upload), and frontmatter.
- Flexible command-line options for selecting platforms, previewing output, and exporting.
- Simple environment variable setup for platform credentials and configuration.
